responsibility: Defines shared debuginfo classification helpers for codegen, deciding when Rust enums should be described as C-like enumerations versus structured variant layouts and deriving the underlying tag base type used to represent enum or coroutine discriminants in emitted debug metadata.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is a small helper module for debuginfo-specific decisions, centered on enum debuginfo classification and related type-name support. It does not organize broad backend subsystems, own MIR codegen state, or define backend-facing trait contracts.
